title: Brother Osk's on-screen 'Brother Osk disapproves (-1)' message for a witnessed theft did not decrement his tracked regard, confirmed twice by an immediate status check on the same turn (turn 60: candles theft, regard stayed 0; turn 199: tally-sticks theft, regard stayed +4). His approvals, by contrast, always landed correctly (0 -> +4 via three approvals). The disapprove branch appears to silently no-op for this companion.
where: Gray Chapel / Captain Vane's Tent - 'take a bundle of blessed candles' and 'take a bundle of Company tally-sticks'
